Every length-n<=3^k factor crosses at most one two-supertile boundary, so direct partial-prefix differences constrain its signed sum to [-2k-1,2k+1]. Fixed parity thus gives at most 2k+2 distinct Parikh vectors. The adjacent aligned block U_k overline(U_k), which occurs since 01 occurs in the underlying word, realizes signed weight -(2k+1) by choosing prefix maximizing P_k; complement closure of the factor language realizes +(2k+1). Sliding windows interpolate all intermediate counts, proving exact rho(3^k)=2k+2 and max for n<=3^k, hence global logarithmic envelope and limsup=2. Direct construction from the substitution independently confirmed counts at k=0..6; these finite checks do not replace the exact supertile argument.
